items.text: Oil valves every 2–3 playing days, not weekly, if they start feeling sluggish. Never use hot water on a lacquered horn — lukewarm only.
2,450 kcal · 195g protein a day. Protein is the one that decides whether you lose fat or lose muscle — hit it even on bad days. Full plan and Sunday prep walkthrough in nutrition/PLAN.md.
Buy the skincare 4: gentle cleanser (CeraVe/Cetaphil) · Differin adapalene 0.1% gel · moisturizer with SPF 30 · PanOxyl 10% benzoyl peroxide body wash. All at Walmart, about $45 total.

It gets WORSE around weeks 2-4 before it gets better. That is purging, not failure, and it is where everyone quits. Real results at 8-12 weeks. Benzoyl peroxide bleaches fabric — use old towels and a white shirt after.
If you get painful deep nodules, scarring, or nothing improves by 12 weeks, see a dermatologist — that is prescription territory and worth it. UTD Student Health can refer you.

Texas six-withdrawals rule: you get SIX course withdrawals total across your entire undergrad career in Texas public schools. Key detail — dropping BEFORE the Sep 9 deadline means no W at all, so it does not count against the six. After Sep 9 it does.
Trash OUT 4–6pm (Sun, Mon, Wed) · bin back IN next morning as you leave (Mon, Tue, Thu)

Your trash cycle: OUT Sunday, Monday, Wednesday afternoons. IN Monday, Tuesday, Thursday mornings on your way out the door. Tuesday and Thursday you get home after 6 so you cannot put it out, and bins are banned Friday and Saturday. Three pickups a week is plenty for one person.

items.text: Activate the Oct–Dec 5% cashback categories: restaurants, entertainment, UTILITIES. It does not apply automatically, and you now have a utility bill.

Card utilization is 32% ($1,120 of $3,500). Under 30% is where it stops affecting your credit score — which matters for apartments and car loans after graduation. Paying in full each month fixes both this and the interest.
